description:
Retrieve schema lint violations from a graph's most recent schema checks: for each check, the subgraph and variant it ran against and when it completed, and each diagnostic's coordinate, severity level, message, rule, and source location, plus error/warning/total/ignored counts.
These are past check results, not a lint of the current schema; use LintSchema to lint a schema now.
Provide the graph ID.
Without filters the results span every variant and subgraph on the graph, so pass variants and subgraphs to narrow them, and check implementingServiceName, baseVariant, and completedAt on each result.
Optionally set a limit (default 5 most recent schema checks).
name: GetLintResults
